body: Dollar pinned near four-year low after Trump comments fuel selling. Oil prices hover around four-month high, buoyed by weak dollar and U.S. storm. South Korea's Kospi hits record high for second straight session. European stocks rise after EU's 'mother of all deals' with India. Dollar sinks to four-year low as intervention risk lifts yen. South Korea's Kospi hits fresh record as Trump levels tariff threats against Seoul. Asia-Pacific stocks trade mixed as geopolitical worries keep investors on edge. European stocks close higher after Trump's Greenland 'deal,' tariffs retreat. Asia stocks rebound after Trump walks back on Europe tariff threats. European markets fall after Trump's Greenland tariffs threat; autos sell off. Oil prices rise as supply risk remain in focus. Asia chips rise after U.S.-Taiwan trade deal; Taiex and Kospi hit fresh records. South Korea stocks hit record high after Bank of Korea keeps interest rate unchanged. European stocks mixed as focus shifts to Greenland talks.
